# Reproducibility of R code {#sec-reproducibility}


All steps in this workflow were written in R and the project structure rendered using quarto. 

```{r}
library(quarto)
R.version
quarto_version()
```

## Installing from source

Three R package were installed from GitHub repositories:

```{r}
#| eval: false
pak::pak("ecoSynthesis")
pak::pak("Global-Ecosystems-Atlas/geco")
```
